title: Prevent failed payments from confirming an order
intent: Improve failed-payment handling so failed orders cannot transition to confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: A declined or timed-out payment leaves the order in FAILED status, not CONFIRMED
A successfully captured payment still confirms the order (regression)
expected_risks: This is a direct correctness bug: apply_payment_result checks `payment.amount > 0` (always true) instead of `payment.status == PaymentStatus.CAPTURED`
A customer could be told their order is confirmed when the charge actually failed
expected_tests: a declined payment results in a FAILED order, not CONFIRMED
a captured payment still results in a CONFIRMED order (regression)
expected_failure_modes: apply_payment_result checks payment.amount > 0 instead of payment.status (current bug)
